definition: Approximate London annual housing requirement under the government's standard method; combines dwelling stock and affordability indicators, not a direct count of households applying for homes.
London Plan ten-year housing target, intended as a deliverable planning target; not equivalent to independently estimated underlying need.
caution: Historic policy target; not a current measure of total demand.

definition: GLA 2017 Strategic Housing Market Assessment estimate of annual new housing need; different period and methodology from current standard method.
